description: This Java source file defines the IntegrationModulesLoader class, which loads and parses JSON configuration files to create IntegrationModule objects with associated configurations and details.

classes.name: IntegrationModulesLoader
classes.description: A component class responsible for loading and parsing JSON configuration files into IntegrationModule objects with detailed configurations.

methods.name: loadIntegrationModules
methods.description: Loads a list of IntegrationModule objects from a JSON file specified by its path.

methods.name: loadModule
methods.description: Parses a Map representing a module's JSON data into an IntegrationModule object, including configurations, details, and regions.
